description: Source code for Zephyr RTOS shell RTT backend implementation, managing RTT buffers, initialization, data transmission, and event handling.

methods.name: timer_handler
methods.description: Handles timer events, triggers RX ready event if data is available.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the shell RTT transport, configures buffers, and starts polling timer.

methods.name: uninit
methods.description: Stops the polling timer for the shell RTT transport.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the shell RTT transport, stops timer if blocking.

methods.name: is_panic_mode
methods.description: Checks if the system is in panic mode.

methods.name: is_sync_mode
methods.description: Determines if the transport operates in synchronous mode based on configuration.

methods.name: on_failed_write
methods.description: Handles failed write attempts, adjusts host presence and delays retries.

methods.name: on_write
methods.description: Handles successful write, manages panic mode behavior and host disconnection detection.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to RTT buffer, manages retries and host presence.

methods.name: enable_shell_rtt
methods.description: Initializes the shell RTT subsystem during system startup.

methods.name: shell_backend_rtt_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shell RTT instance for testing.
